summary: Exactly nt RK4 steps with ordered stage-wise field feedback; O(nv+nt) memory.

identity.relation: Exactly nt RK4 steps with ordered stage-wise field feedback; O(nv+nt) memory.
identity.definition: Exactly nt RK4 steps with ordered stage-wise field feedback; O(nv+nt) memory.
identity.model: Linear one-dimensional single-spatial-Fourier-mode electrons, fixed ions.
identity.geometry: One velocity coordinate and one spatial Fourier mode.
identity.boundary: Finite velocity window; endpoint-inclusive full-weight rectangle quadrature. Fn4 weak derivative deposits cutoff deltas; selected smooth variant omits them.
assumptions: Velocity-window truncation and recurrence are separate from temporal integration error.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: State mapping produced by vp_init, with df,dE,vv,df0dv,k,dv,dt,nt and source controls.
inputs.constraints: Complete VP state; finite aligned arrays; Poisson-closed initial field; integer nt>=0.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: State mapping: Fn,kappa,nv,dt,nt,k,vmax,vmin,dv,TR; vv,df,df0dv [nv+1]; scalar dE; dEt,tt [nt+1]; wr,wi are kappa=1 theory or None. Fields and arrays are independently owned. Input is not mutated; repeated calls start a new local time trace from supplied df.
outputs.shape: As described in output mapping or tuple.
outputs.constraints: Finite result except documented log-zero -inf and absent theory/diagnostics.

preconditions: state contains a finite Poisson-consistent vp_init mapping and integer nt>=0.
supported: Exactly nt ordered RK4 steps with copied state and dEt/tt histories.
excluded: Nonlinear evolution, multidimensional modes and adaptive time stepping.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for missing/invalid state controls or an initial Poisson inconsistency.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError propagated from a nonfinite RK4 state or field.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the step count is prescribed and no convergence test is run.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No evolved state is returned; the caller-supplied mapping is copied before stepping and is not mutated.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.vlasov_poisson import vp_init,vp_evolve
s=vp_evolve(vp_init(nv=32,nt=5))
assert s["dEt"].shape == (6,)
example.description: Initialize and evolve five finite RK4 steps on a 32-interval grid.

scope: Discrete Poisson constraint and off-diagonal rank-one feedback.
Dense matrix-exponential RK4 order; analytic free-streaming and damped-cosine diagnostics.
Slowing-down weak derivative integration-by-parts and default 2049-node/2000-step execution.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent semidiscrete mathematical and selected scenario regressions; actual run/installed-wheel receipts are recorded separately, not inferred from test existence.
known_limitations: Finite-window rectangle rule and sampling recurrence TR=2pi/(k*dv).
Fn4 truncated density retains original coefficient and is not renormalized after cutoff.
Peak diagnostic assumes standing oscillation; rotating complex exponential has no amplitude peaks.
